source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Use the OSHA 301 form, or a company-specific equivalent,
3. Capture employee information
   - Name
   - Social Security number (SSN)
   - Date and time of the accident
   - Brief description of the injury/illness
   - Employment information (job title, department, shift)
4. Record the incident details
   - Date and time of the incident
   - Location of the accident within the workplace
   - Description of what happened (be specific and avoid subjective statements)
   - Cause of the accident (include any contributing factors or safety violations)
   - Description of injury/illness and parts of the body affected
   - Medical treatment received (including date, time, and provider)
   - Witnesses to the accident (names and contact details)
   - Photographs or sketches (if possible)
5. Ensure objective reporting
   - Avoid blame or fault-finding language
   - Stick to facts
